1.def: Present Perfect hozirga aloqasi bor, vaqti aniq bo'lmagan yoki hali tugamagan davrdagi ishni bildiradi; Past Simple tugagan, aniq o'tgan vaqtdagi ishni. O'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham o'tgan zamon bo'lgani uchun adashish ko'p uchraydi.
forms: I have lived here since 2015. I've lost my keys.
I saw her yesterday. We moved in 2018.
today, this week, this year + Perfect; tugagan davr + Simple
I have called him twice today. / I called him twice yesterday.
rules: Aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, ago, in 2019, last night, When...?) bilan FAQAT Past Simple.
Natija hozir ko'rinsa — Perfect: I've broken my leg (hozir gipsda).
been (borib qaytgan) / gone (ketgan, qaytmagan); first time + Perfect: It's the first time I've flown.
ex: She has worked here for ten years. (hozir ham ishlaydi)
U o'n yildan beri shu yerda ishlaydi.
She worked there for ten years. (endi yo'q)
U o'n yil u yerda ishlagan.
Have you finished? — Yes, I finished an hour ago.
Tugatdingmi? — Ha, bir soat oldin tugatdim.

2.def: Present Perfect Simple — natija va tugallanganlik (nechta, necha marta); Present Perfect Continuous — jarayon va davomiylik (qancha vaqt, hozirgina tugagan faoliyat izi).
forms: I've been writing emails all morning.
How many / How much + Simple; How long + Continuous
How many pages have you read? How long have you been reading?
rules: Natija, son, tugallanganlik → Simple; jarayon, davomiylik, ta'sir izi → Continuous.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, own, belong) Continuous bo'lmaydi.
live, work, study ikkalasida ham mumkin: I've lived / been living here for years.
ex: I've painted the kitchen. (tayyor)
Oshxonani bo'yadim. (bo'yalgan)
I've been painting the kitchen. (jarayon)
Oshxonani bo'yayapman / bo'yab turibman.
She's been crying; her eyes are red.
U yig'lagan; ko'zlari qizarib ketgan.
err: I've been knowing him for years.
I've been reading three books this week.
I've read three books this week.

3.def: Uch zamonni birgalikda ishlatish: Past Simple — ketma-ket voqealar; Past Continuous — fon yoki jarayon; Past Perfect — undan oldingi voqea. Hikoyada vaqt tartibini aniq ko'rsatadi.
forms: He opened the door and went in.
It was raining when I left.
When I arrived, the train had left.
rules: Oldin bo'lgan voqea — had + V3; keyin bo'lgan — Past Simple.
Fon / jarayon (while, as, at that time) — Continuous.
after + Past Perfect, Past Simple; before + Past Simple, Past Perfect — ikkalasi ham mumkin, ammo Perfect ishlatilganda tartib aniq bo'ladi.
ex: I was walking home when I realised I had left my phone at work.
Uyga ketayotib telefonimni ishda qoldirganimni anglab qoldim.
She had already eaten when we came.
Biz kelganimizda u allaqachon ovqatlangan edi.
While we were talking, the lights went out.
Gaplashayotganimizda chiroq o'chdi.
err: When I got there, the film already started.

4.def: Hikoya zamonlari (narrative tenses) va Past Perfect Continuous: hikoyada tarkibiy qismlarni bog'laydi. Past Perfect Continuous — boshqa o'tgan voqeadan oldin davom etgan jarayon.
forms: She had been waiting for two hours when he arrived.
It was dark; we had been walking for hours when we saw a light.
rules: Perfect Continuous — davomiylik / sabab: He was tired because he had been working all night.
Perfect Simple — natija / son: He had written five reports.
Holat fe'llari Continuous olmaydi.
ex: The ground was wet. It had been raining all night.
Yer ho'l edi. Tun bo'yi yomg'ir yoqqan edi.
I had been studying for hours, so I was exhausted.
Soatlab o'qigan edim, shuning uchun horg'in edim.
They had been living there for years before they moved.
Ko'chib ketishdan oldin ular u yerda yillar yashagan.
err: She was tired because she worked all night.
... because she had been working all night.

5.def: used to, would, be used to, get used to: o'tmish odati va ko'nikish. used to — holat va odat; would — faqat takroriy harakatlar (holat emas); be / get used to + -ing — ko'nikma.
forms: I used to live in Bukhara.
Every summer we would visit my grandparents.
I'm used to waking up early. I'm getting used to it.
rules: Holat fe'llari (be, have, know, live) faqat used to bilan: I used to have a dog (would emas).
would — vaqt belgilangach (every summer, when I was a child).
be used to + -ing; get used to + -ing: to — predlog.
ex: When I was a child, I would play outside for hours.
Bolaligimda soatlab tashqarida o'ynardim.
She used to be shy, but now she isn't.
U ilgari uyatchan edi, hozir yo'q.
After a month I got used to the noise.
Bir oydan keyin shovqinga ko'nikdim.
err: I would live in Samarkand when I was a child.
I'm used to get up early.
I'm used to getting up early.

6.def: Kelasi zamon shakllari: will, going to, Present Continuous, Present Simple (jadval), future continuous (will be doing), future perfect (will have done). Har biri vaziyatga qarab tanlanadi.
forms: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Dubai.
rules: will: qaror, bashorat, va'da; going to: reja va belgi; Present Continuous: kelishilgan reja; Present Simple: rasmiy jadval.
Future Continuous — kelasi paytda jarayonda bo'lamiz; Future Perfect — shu paytgacha tugatgan bo'lamiz.
by + vaqt — Future Perfect belgisi: by Friday, by the time.
ex: By next June I will have finished my degree.
Kelasi iyunga qadar darajamni tugatgan bo'laman.
At 8 pm tomorrow I will be watching the match.
Ertaga kechqurun soat 8 da o'yin ko'rib o'tirgan bo'laman.
The conference starts at 9 on Monday.
Konferensiya dushanba kuni soat 9 da boshlanadi.
err: By 5 pm I will have finished.
Tomorrow I will be meeting him / I'm meeting him.

7.def: 0, 1 va 2-turdagi shart gaplar va ularning murakkab bog'lovchilari: unless (agar ... bo'lmasa), as long as / provided (providing) (faqat shart bilan), in case (ehtiyot shart). Har birining ma'nosi aniq.
forms: If you heat water to 100°, it boils. If it rains, we'll stay.
If I had more time, I'd learn Spanish.
unless = if ... not; as long as / provided that = only if; in case + Present
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
rules: unless + darak fe'l (inkor emas): Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
in case — ehtiyot choralari; if — shart bajarilsa natija.
if-qismida will / would ishlatilmaydi.
ex: I'll go as long as you come with me.
Sen men bilan kelsang, boraman.
Take a coat in case it gets cold.
Sovuq bo'lib qolishi mumkinligi uchun palto ol.
Unless you leave now, you'll miss the bus.
Hozir chiqmasangiz, avtobusga kech qolasiz.
err: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
In case it will rain, take an umbrella.
In case it rains, take an umbrella.

8.def: Third (o'tmish) va mixed (aralash) conditional. Third — o'tmishdagi real bo'lmagan holat va natijasi; mixed — o'tmishdagi shart hozirgi natijaga yoki aksincha ta'sir qiladi.
forms: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3
If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If + Past Simple, would have + V3
If she were more careful, she wouldn't have broken it.
rules: Natija qaysi vaqtga tegishli ekaniga qarab shakl tanlanadi (now, today — would + fe'l; yesterday — would have + V3).
could have / might have ham mumkin.
If-qismida would have yo'q.
ex: If I had taken the job, I would be living in London now.
Ishni olganimda hozir Londonda yashagan bo'lardim.
If you had told me, I would have helped.
Menga aytganingda yordam bergan bo'lardim.
If he weren't so lazy, he would have passed.
U dangasa bo'lmasa, o'tgan bo'lardi.
err: If I would have known, I would have gone.
If I had known, I would have gone.
If I had won, I would have been rich now.

9.def: Wish, if only, would rather, had better, it's time — afsus, istak va maslahat bildiruvchi konstruksiyalar. Hozirga afsus — Past Simple, o'tmishga afsus — Past Perfect, noroziliq — would.
forms: I wish I had a bigger flat. If only I were taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
I wish you would stop talking.
rules: would rather + fe'l (xohlardim): I'd rather stay. Boshqa shaxs bilan: I'd rather you stayed (Past Simple).
had better + fe'l (to'g'risi shu): You'd better hurry.
It's time + Past Simple: It's time we left (ketadigan payt keldi).
ex: I wish I could speak French.
Fransuzcha gapira olsam edi.
If only I had listened to you!
Seni tinglaganimda edi!
You had better see a doctor.
Shifokorga ko'ringaning ma'qul.
err: I wish I have more time.
I wish I had more time.

10.def: Majhul nisbat har qanday zamonda ishlatiladi: be + V3. have / get something done — boshqa odam bizning uchun ish qilgani (xizmat). Bajaruvchi muhim bo'lmasa yoki noma'lum bo'lsa passiv qulay.
forms: is made / was made / has been made / will be made
I had my hair cut. She got her car repaired.
rules: Ikkita to'ldiruvchili fe'llar: He was given a book (shaxs bosh); A book was given to him.
have something done — xizmat; boshqa odam qilgan.
Reflexive (cut my own hair) bilan adashtirmang: I cut my hair (o'zim) / I had my hair cut (sartarosh).
ex: The report is being written now.
Hisobot hozir yozilmoqda.
I'm having my flat painted next week.
Kelasi hafta kvartiramni bo'yatyapman.
He was offered a better job.
Unga yaxshiroq ish taklif qilindi.
err: I had my hair cut yesterday.
The room is cleaned every day.

11.def: Ko'chirma gap: boshqa odam gapini zamon bir pog'ona orqaga surib yetkazamiz. Ko'chirma savolda darak tartibi, buyruqda to + fe'l ishlatiladi.
forms: do → did; did / have done → had done; will → would; can → could; may → might
«I will call» → She said she would call.
He asked what time the film started. She asked if I was ready.
now → then; today → that day; yesterday → the day before; tomorrow → the next day
He said he had seen it the day before.
rules: Hozirgi vaqtda ham haqiqat bo'lsa zamon surilmasligi mumkin.
must → had to; should, would, could, might o'zgarmaydi.
say + gap; tell + kimga; ask + kimdan.
ex: «I've never been abroad,» she said. → She said she had never been abroad.
U hech xorijda bo'lmaganini aytdi.
He asked me where I was going.
U mendan qayerga ketayotganimni so'radi.
They said they would be late.
Ular kech qolishlarini aytishdi.
err: She asked me where did I work.
She asked me where I worked.
He said me he was tired.
He told me he was tired.

12.def: Reporting verbs — said / told / asked dan tashqari ko'chirmada ma'noni aniqroq beruvchi fe'llar (suggest, promise, admit, deny, warn...). Har biri o'ziga xos tuzilma bilan keladi.
forms: He promised to call. She refused to help.
advise, warn, invite, remind, tell, ask, order
She advised me to rest. He warned us not to go.
admit, deny, suggest, apologise for, accuse of
He admitted stealing. She suggested going home.
rules: suggest + -ing yoki suggest (that) + ega + (should) + fe'l; suggest + to + fe'l emas.
apologise for + -ing; accuse sb of + -ing; insist on + -ing.
Fe'lni to'g'ri guruhga qarab yodlash kerak.
ex: She suggested taking a taxi.
U taksiga o'tirishni taklif qildi.
He denied breaking the window.
U derazani sindirganini inkor qildi.
The doctor warned me not to eat late.
Shifokor kech ovqatlanmaslikni ogohlantirdi.
err: He suggested going / that I go.

13.def: Deduction modallari: hozirgi va o'tmish haqida mavjud dalillarga qarab taxmin qilish: must (albatta), might / may / could (ehtimol), can't (aslo emas). O'tmishda have + V3 ishlatiladi.
forms: She must be at work. He might be sleeping.
must / might / could / can't + have + V3
He must have missed the bus.
That can't have been Tom — he's abroad.
rules: Inkor taxmin — can't (mustn't emas).
couldn't have = can't have (aslo bo'lishi mumkin emas edi).
Taxmin ma'nosi: must have — «bo'lsa kerak edi»; boshqa ma'no: must — majburiyat.
ex: The streets are wet. It must have rained.
Ko'chalar ho'l. Yomg'ir yoqqan bo'lsa kerak.
She can't have forgotten; she wrote it down.
U unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; yozib qo'ygan.
They might have got lost.
Ular adashib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin.

14.def: O'tmishdagi majburiyat va afsus: should have (qilishi kerak edi, lekin qilmadi), shouldn't have (qilmasligi kerak edi), needn't have (kerak emas edi), could have (qila olardi, lekin qilmadi), had to (majbur edi).
forms: I could have won, but I made a mistake.
rules: had to — o'tgan zamondagi majburiyat; must o'tmishga yo'q.
needn't have done — qildi, lekin kerak emas edi; didn't need to — qilish kerak emas edi (qilgan-qilmaganligi noma'lum).
ought to have = should have.
ex: I should have studied more.
Ko'proq o'qishim kerak edi.
You shouldn't have shouted at her.
Unga baqirmasliging kerak edi.
We had to leave early because of the storm.
Bo'ron tufayli erta ketishimizga to'g'ri keldi.

15.def: Ba'zi fe'llar gerund (-ing) yoki infinitive (to + fe'l) bilan ishlatilganda ma'nosi o'zgaradi: remember, forget, stop, try, regret, go on, mean. Ma'noni to'g'ri tanlash muhim.
forms: to + fe'l — ishni qilish kerakligini; -ing — o'tgan ishni
Remember to lock the door. I remember locking it.
stop + -ing — to'xtatish; stop + to + fe'l — maqsad bilan to'xtash
He stopped smoking. He stopped to smoke.
try + to — urinish; try + -ing — tajriba qilib ko'rish
I tried to open it. Try restarting the phone.
rules: regret to say (afsus bilan aytish) / regret saying (qilganidan afsus).
go on doing — davom etish; go on to do — keyingi bosqichga o'tish.
mean to do — niyat; mean doing — ma'no / natija.
ex: I forgot to buy milk, so we have none.
Sut olishni unutdim, shuning uchun yo'q.
I'll never forget meeting her.
Uni uchratganimni hech unutmayman.
If you have a headache, try drinking water.
Boshing og'risa, suv ichib ko'r.

16.def: Fe'l tuzilmalari: fe'lga qarab -ing, to + fe'l yoki ob'ekt + to + fe'l keladi. Ob'ekt bilan: want sb to do, tell sb to do, let / make sb do (to yo'q), help sb (to) do.
forms: want, ask, tell, advise, allow, expect, teach + sb + to do
He made me wait. They let us go.
enjoy, avoid, suggest, consider, risk, keep, mind
rules: make / let — to YO'Q; passivda make → to bo'ladi: He was made to wait.
see / hear / watch + sb + fe'l (to'liq) yoki + -ing (jarayon).
allow sb to do; permit sb to do — lekin allow doing.
ex: The teacher made us write the essay again.
O'qituvchi bizni inshoni qayta yozishga majbur qildi.
I'd like you to meet my friend.
Sizni do'stim bilan tanishtirmoqchiman.
She let her son stay up late.
U o'g'lining kech yotishiga ruxsat berdi.

17.def: Relative clauses — otni aniqlashtiruvchi yoki qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi gaplar. Defining (vergulsiz) — zarur ma'lumot; non-defining (vergulli) — qo'shimcha ma'lumot.
forms: ot + who / which / that / whose / where + gap
The woman who lives upstairs is a nurse.
My sister, who lives in Dubai, is a nurse.
ot + predlog + whom / which; predlog oxirida ham mumkin
The man to whom I spoke / the man I spoke to.
rules: That non-defining'da ishlatilmaydi.
Defining'da to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa who / which / that tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin.
which butun gap haqida: He passed, which surprised me.
what = the thing that: I don't know what he wants.
ex: This is the house where I grew up.
Bu men katta bo'lgan uy.
The film, which was long, won an award.
Film, u uzun edi, mukofot oldi.
The person whose car was stolen called the police.
Mashinasi o'g'irlangan odam politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.
err: The man, that I met, was kind.
The man (that) I met was kind.
The woman who her son is a doctor ...
The woman whose son is a doctor ...

18.def: Artikllar: a / an (noaniq, birlik), the (aniq), artiklsiz (umumiy ma'noda ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar). Tanlov — tinglovchi nima haqida gap ketayotganini bilishiga bog'liq.
forms: birinchi marta eslash, kasb, birlik ma'no
I saw a dog. She is an engineer.
ikkinchi marta, yagona, tinglovchi biladigan, orttirma daraja
The dog was big. The sun is hot. the best
umumiy ko'plik / sanalmaydigan; ovqat, til, ko'p mamlakat
I love music. Dogs are loyal. We have lunch at one.
rules: the: yagona narsalar (the Moon), daryo, dengiz, okean, tog' tizmasi (the Alps), mamlakatlar ko'plik / Republic (the USA, the UK).
Artikl yo'q: shahar, ko'pchilik mamlakat, ko'cha nomi, til, fan: Uzbekistan, English, history.
Muassasa asosiy vazifasi uchun artiklsiz: go to school / hospital / bed; bino sifatida the: go to the school (borib ko'rish).
ex: The Nile is the longest river in Africa.
Nil — Afrikadagi eng uzun daryo.
He is at university; she is at the university today.
U universitetda o'qiydi; u bugun universitet binosida.
Life is short.
Hayot qisqa.

19.def: Quantifiers — miqdor so'zlari va otlarning sanaladigan / sanalmaydigan turi. Sanalmaydiganlar: information, advice, news, furniture, luggage, equipment, progress, traffic, knowledge, work, homework.
forms: many, a few, few, fewer, several, a number of
much, a little, little, less, an amount of
a lot of, lots of, plenty of, some, any, enough, most, all
rules: Sanalmaydigan ot -s olmaydi va 'a' qo'yilmaydi: a piece of advice, an item of news.
Fe'l birlikda: The news is good.
each / every + birlik; both / several + ko'plik; either / neither + birlik.
ex: I need some advice about my studies.
O'qishim haqida maslahat kerak.
There are fewer cars than last year.
Mashinalar o'tgan yilgiga qaraganda kam.
Most students passed, and all of them were happy.
O'quvchilarning ko'pchiligi o'tdi va barchasi xursand edi.
err: He gave me a good advice.
He gave me good advice / a piece of advice.

20.def: Comparison and degree — qiyoslash va daraja: -er / more, -est / most, as ... as, the + qiyosiy ... the + qiyosiy, hamda daraja ravishlari: quite, rather, fairly, pretty, extremely, absolutely.
forms: much / far / a lot / slightly / a bit + qiyosiy
This is much cheaper. It's slightly warmer.
absolutely / completely + (terrible, perfect, fantastic); very emas
rules: very + chegaralanadigan sifat (cold, tired); absolutely + chegaralanmaydigan (freezing, exhausted).
fairly < quite < rather < pretty < very < extremely.
than + olmosh: taller than I am / than me (og'zaki).
ex: The new phone is far better than the old one.
Yangi telefon eskisidan ancha yaxshi.
She was absolutely delighted.
U juda xursand edi.
It's getting more and more difficult.
Borgan sari qiyinlashayapti.

21.def: Confusing word pairs — shakli yoki ma'nosi o'xshash, lekin ishlatilishi boshqa bo'lgan so'zlar. Ularni juft bo'lib yodlash kerak.
forms: He said hello. He told me a story.
make a mistake, make food; do homework, do business
borrow / lend; bring / take; look / see / watch
borrow — olish; lend — berish; bring — keltirish (bu yerga); take — olib ketish
Can I borrow your pen? Please bring it here.
rules: lose (yo'qotmoq) — loose (bo'sh); affect (ta'sir qilmoq, fe'l) — effect (ta'sir, ot).
economic (iqtisodiy) — economical (tejamkor); historic (tarixiy muhim) — historical (tarixga oid).
hear (beixtiyor eshitish) — listen (diqqat bilan tinglash); look / watch / see.
ex: She lent me her book, so I borrowed it for a week.
U menga kitobini berdi, bir haftaga oldim.
I made a mistake and had to do the work again.
Xato qildim va ishni qayta bajarishga to'g'ri keldi.
The weather affected the result; the effect was clear.
Ob-havo natijaga ta'sir qildi; ta'sir aniq edi.
err: Can you lend me your pen? (olmoqchiman)

22.def: Dependent prepositions — ba'zi fe'l, sifat va otlar bilan doim bir xil predlog keladi (depend on, afraid of). Vaqt va joy predloglari (at / on / in) ham qat'iy qoidaga amal qiladi.
forms: depend on, rely on, believe in, listen to, wait for, apologise for
afraid of, good at, interested in, keen on, tired of, responsible for
at 5, on Monday, in 2020; at the station, on the table, in London
rules: Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ing: interested in learning.
look at / for / after / forward to; arrive at (bino), in (shahar); different from / to.
Predlog bilan fe'l tuzilmasini juft yodlash kerak.
ex: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
Sizni ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
He apologised for being late.
U kechikkani uchun uzr so'radi.
We arrived at the hotel in Paris on Friday.
Juma kuni Parijda mehmonxonaga yetib keldik.

23.def: Phrasal verbs — fe'l + zarracha (predlog / ravish) birikmasi bo'lib, o'z ma'nosiga ega: give up = taslim bo'lmoq. Ba'zilari bo'linadi (ob'ekt o'rtaga kiradi), ba'zilari bo'linmaydi.
forms: fe'l + ob'ekt + zarracha / fe'l + zarracha + ob'ekt
turn off the light / turn the light off
turn it off (turn off it emas)
look after, get over, run into
rules: Ob'ekt olmosh bo'lsa, u o'rtada turishi shart: pick it up.
Ob'ektsiz phrasal verb: The car broke down. I woke up.
Uch qismli: look forward to, put up with, get on with (bo'linmaydi).
ex: I gave up smoking last year.
O'tgan yili chekishni tashladim.
Can you switch the TV off?
Televizorni o'chira olasizmi?
We ran out of milk, so I'll pick some up.
Sutimiz tugab qoldi, olib kelaman.
err: I look forward to meet you.
I look forward to meeting you.

24.def: Linking words — fikrni bog'laydigan so'zlar: qarama-qarshilik (although, whereas, however), sabab-natija (therefore, as a result), qo'shimcha (moreover, in addition), maqsad (so that). Ular yozma va og'zaki nutqni uyushtiradi.
forms: although / even though + gap; despite / in spite of + ot / -ing; however, ...
Although he was tired, he kept working.
because, since, as; so, therefore, as a result, consequently
It was late, so we left. He failed; therefore, he'll retake.
moreover, in addition, besides; for example, such as
He is smart. Moreover, he is hard-working.
rules: although + gap; despite + ot (the + noun / -ing / the fact that).
however / therefore / moreover — nuqtali vergul yoki nuqtadan keyin, keyin vergul.
whereas / while — ikki holatni solishtirish.
ex: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
Tirbandlikka qaramay, vaqtida yetib keldik.
She is shy, whereas her brother is outgoing.
U uyatchan, akasi esa ochiq.
The shop was closed. As a result, we had to go home.
Do'kon yopiq edi. Natijada uyga qaytishga to'g'ri keldi.
err: Despite he was tired, he worked.
Despite being tired / Although he was tired, he worked.
He was ill, however he went to work.
He was ill; however, he went to work.
